name: da Pino
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to da Pino in Garmisch-Partenkirchen**

Discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of the Alps! At **da Pino**, we bring the flavors of Italy to the Bavarian mountains—fresh pasta, crispy pizza, and hearty antipasti made with love.

Whether you're craving a classic **Spaghetti Bolognese**, a crispy **Pizza Margherita**, or a creamy **Tiramisu**, our menu has something for everyone. Pair your meal with a glass of fine Italian wine or a cold **San Pellegrino** for the perfect alpine dining experience.

Located right in the center of **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, we’re your cozy spot after a day on the slopes or a hike through the stunning **Zugspitze** region. Come in, relax, and enjoy the taste of Italy in the mountains!

**Da Pino – Where Italy meets the Alps.**
